segments.dry: One reviewer with very dry skin who uses masks for an intense moisture boost a couple of times a week reports this one stayed on well and left her skin plumper and deeply hydrated with no irritation.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports this is the first mask she has used that doesn't irritate or burn her skin, though she didn't notice much visible difference beyond the immediate post-removal effect.
segments.mature: One reviewer who says she increasingly feels the need for more collagen and hydration as she ages reports the mask delivered a noticeable boost in plumpness and hydration after using it twice.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report visible plumping and firming effects, including one who says the mask reduced the wrinkle between her eyebrows after repeat use and another who describes a younger, fuller-looking appearance the morning after an overnight application.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers consistently report a strong, immediate hydration boost, describing skin as plumper, softer, and smoother right after use, including one reviewer with very dry skin who found it deeply hydrating; several note the effect is short-lived, working best as a quick boost rather than a long-term replacement for a daily moisturizer.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin report no burning or irritation, including one for whom this was the first mask that didn't irritate or burn her skin, and others who specifically note no irritation despite skin sensitivities.

Once I removed it my skin felt plumper and deeply hydrated. I really like this mask.

On days when your skin needs a little more moisture, this made in Korea hydrogel mask is a cool choice. The gel-like texture provides a cooling sensation that is immediately calming and sticks to the face well without slipping. It is a pleasant pick-me-up for dry or exhausted complexions because it leaves skin feeling plumper and more revitalized after use. I love that they are fragrance free. On the down side, the masks require careful handling during application due to their fragility. It is more effective as a short-term boost than a long-term fix because the hydration impact is evident but temporary. All things considered, these masks are a fun and easy way to hydrate your skin more, especially when you want to have a spa-like experience at home. Instead of replacing a daily moisturizer, they work best for temporary refreshment.
